limitations: No new optimization, campaign, SQL, service, Git or publication action performed
Timing targets remain portable and unenforced under D-148; actual merged run has 47 profile, 115 property and 1 other workflow target misses
4 deliberate policy misses are separate from 163 actual workflow misses; exact per-observation values and predicates are retained above
Hidden retirement and hidden visible-current observations remain null/unavailable, never measured zero
Mobile Chromium is existing emulation, not physical-device qualification
Sampled individual child and parent RSS peaks are not simultaneous or aggregate peak memory; browser/GPU peak unavailable
Observer job sets can include earlier shared-store jobs; ownership is established by source/project and native report bindings, not all observed jobs
Recorded hard-order proof and contiguous trace/hash/source bindings inspected; this audit does not rerun the original TypeScript assertion implementation
No speedup, strict-host, universal-capacity or final merged/release/readiness claim
